capabilities: Sync highlights, notes, reviews and annotations from BookFusion into the vault
Customize exported content, filenames and frontmatter with Liquid templates
Choose an update policy (Magic, Smart Insert, Append, Replace) for re-syncs
Schedule automatic syncing at intervals from 30 minutes to 24 hours
Sync different content and templates to multiple vaults
extras: BookFusion is a paid service with a free tier limited to 10 books; sync is one-way (BookFusion to Obsidian) and requires network access. Detailed tutorials are linked rather than fully inline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull reading highlights and annotations from BookFusion's e-book and PDF reader into local Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: BookFusion is a seperate and external service from Obsidian.

requires.name: BookFusion paid plan (free tier limited to 10 books)

summary: BookFusion connector that syncs e-book highlights, notes, reviews and annotations from the BookFusion service into vault notes.
